the direction of magnetic field at a point directly below it?         [1] 
Ans: Using Right Hand Thumb Rule the direction of field at a point above the line with the 
horizontal and toward the north and the at a point below will be horizontal and toward the south. 
5. Two lamps one rated 100 watt at 220 volt and other 60 watt and 220 volt are connected 
in parallel to electric main supply. What current is drawn from the main line if the supply 
voltage is 220 volt?[2] 
Ans:  current drawn from 100w- 
 I1 = P1/V = 100/220 = 0.4545A   
Current drawn from 60w 
 I2 = P2/V = 60/220 = 0.2727A  
 Current drawn from the main line, I = I1 + I2 = 0.4545 + 0.2727 = 0.727A
